prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1319; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The front bumper cover is cracked across the center and the upper radiator support has shifted, which lines up with the frontal impact described. The left headlamp assembly is broken and the hood shows creasing near the leading edge. Damage is confined to the front end, and the parts list reflects a straightforward front-end repair plan: replace the bumper cover, headlamp, and hood, realign the radiator support, and refinish affected panels. Labor hours run slightly above what I would expect for this scope, so I have flagged the line items for review with the shop. Nothing I found suggests earlier damage to this vehicle, and the invoices reviewed show no repeated charges for the same work.
